title: Linkers (although / so)
note: Four jobs: addition · contrast · cause/effect · time. Sort = 12 chips into those boxes. Quiz/Type/Use stay on although/so/because confusions. · Bank 48 + sort 12 · 2026-08-28: intro names the four jobs; Check starts with four-box sort. · 2026-09-04 B1 loop: B3 all 48 gap items had no chips — each now offers the answer plus three linkers that are wrong for THIS Czech prompt, never one its own gap_accepts also accepts (but/although, Therefore/So, when/after are accepted pairs). D1 three explanations covered 36 of the 48; each now names its own linker and what has to follow it — a clause, a noun, a new sentence. A8 nine twins closed. C4 'despite / in spite of' bolded as one string is not a bank sentence; each is bolded on its own now (C13).

items.cz: Byl jsem unavený, tak jsem šel domů.

items.gap: They left early ____ the storm.
accepts: They left early because of the storm.
items.explanation: **because of** takes a **noun**, never a clause: *because of the rain*, not *because of it rained*. They left early because of the storm.
items.explanation_cz: **because of** má za sebou **podstatné jméno**, nikdy větu: *because of the rain*, ne *because of it rained*. They left early because of the storm.
items.join: They left early. There was a storm.

cards.title: What they are
points: Linking joins two ideas and shows how they relate
A linker is often a conjunction: *because, so, although, but*
Four jobs here — a small set of each

rows: I was tired, **so** I went home.

cards.title: Addition
points: **and** joins two things in one phrase

cards.title: Contrast

rows: I like tea, **but** I prefer coffee.

points: **despite** + a noun, not a clause — *in spite of* is the same
